query: I activated my phone 4 months ago. Will I pay a penalty if I downgrade my plan?
missing_context: No customer ID, current plan or target plan
expected_behavior: Do not state an amount; ask for the missing slots (customer ID, target plan)

query: I want to switch to a senior plan before 180 days have passed. Do I have to pay a penalty?
expected_behavior: Explain the senior exemption (RULE_WELFARE_EXEMPT · DOC_CHUNK_004) and ask for the customer ID

query: How much subsidy do I get if I buy a Galaxy S26 Ultra now?
expected_behavior: Show the total subsidy per plan from the BigQuery subsidy policy

query: If I suspend my line for military enlistment, what happens to the 180-day commitment?
expected_behavior: Cite the military enlistment hold (RULE_MILITARY_HOLD · DOC_CHUNK_004)

query: For the latest iPhone Pro, is the selective contract or the public subsidy better?
missing_context: Device alias ('latest iPhone Pro') and plan not given
expected_behavior: Map to the catalog iPhone 16 Pro and show the 24-month total cost difference from BigQuery

query: It has been 185 days since activation. Is there no penalty if I move to the cheapest LTE plan?
expected_behavior: 0 KRW because 185 elapsed days exceed the commitment period

query: Are there duplicate keys in the subsidy table or the graph node tables?
expected_behavior: Report the measured duplicate-key count of the node tables

query: If I switch from 5G Premier Essential to 5G Direct 61, is that below the baseline?
missing_context: Downgrade between plans above the baseline
expected_behavior: Not a baseline violation because the target plan fee is above the baseline

query: Does the 180-day baseline rule apply the same way to corporate lines?
expected_behavior: State from the tool results whether a segment exception exists and cite RULE_SIX_PLAN_180D

query: If we move to Spanner Graph, do we have to rewrite all our GQL queries and schema?
missing_context: BigQuery Graph vs. Spanner Graph compatibility
expected_behavior: Answer from the measured BigQuery Property Graph results and do not assert anything that is not in them
